why:
IT User Skills will help you to develop your skills in a range of IT software programmes. Each Unit focuses on an element of IT and will also help you to develop your general IT knowledge and skills. 

Each unit is broken down into sessions and focuses on a specific elements of IT which will enable you to develop your skills and understanding of different types of office software and the tasks that they can be used for. These units will also help you to develop your general IT knowledge and skills as well as how to keep yourself and your data secure.
